title: gforth stacks log envelope (candidate, experiment 009)
description: PROPOSAL, not part of contract/ (E-6). What every line of every stacks.jsonl carries, in every version (D-36): v, event, t, and on hello the contract. The payload is everything else and is versioned by the contract schema, not here. Byte rule I-1 (D-38), which a schema cannot state: every line begins with {"v": then a decimal integer then a comma.

v.description: record version: the MAJOR of hello.contract; never renamed, moved, retyped or dropped (I-1)

event.description: record kind; a consumer stops by version, never by event, on one it does not know

t.description: Unix seconds; consumers must not rely on it

contract.description: MAJOR.MINOR of the payload contract; MAJOR equals v

inspect.description: the producer release, X.Y.Z (optional in the envelope; the compound check requires it)
